I’ll inspect the failed validation, fix the cause, and continue the measurements and checks. I’ll use the SASE repo, memory, and bead skills to keep the work and evidence attached to this phase.


The validation passed 124 project-statistics tests and failed one new Python counter assertion. The dependency gate passed: the wheel grew by 0.159 MiB and the measured clean build time stayed within budget. I’m checking the parser behavior behind the failed assertion before rerunning validation.


I found two separate issues. Tokei 15 counts a one-line triple-quoted Python string as code, even with its docstring option enabled; the tests now document that behavior. I also fixed a real bug: lowercase shebang language hints were passed to a case-sensitive lookup, which could give extensionless scripts zero SLOC.


The fixes are ready for validation. Formatting also exposed a broken editable Rust install in the workspace, so I’ve added a repair using the newly built wheel through `just install-venv`. I’ll use a SASE monitor for the tests, wheel build, and benchmarks; the continuation will review the evidence and run both repository checks before closing the phase.
